items.title: 10.16 Standard potential (E cell) ka hisab (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.16 with Figure 10.8, printed pages 230-231.

blocks.text: E standard qeematein do half-cells se bane electrochemical cell ka voltage deti hain chahe koi bhi standard hydrogen electrode na ho: napa gaya voltage dono half-cells ki E standard qeematon ka farq hai, jise standard cell potential, E cell, kehte hain. Figure 10.8 ke cell ke liye half-equations Ag+(aq) + e- se Ag(s), E standard = +0.80 V, aur Zn2+(aq) + 2e- se Zn(s), E standard = -0.76 V hain, to voltage +0.80 - (-0.76) = +1.56 V hai. Ag+/Ag half-cell ki E standard qeemat Zn2+/Zn half-cell se zyada musbat hai, to Ag+/Ag half-cell musbat pole aur Zn2+/Zn half-cell manfi pole hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Ag+ mahlool mein chandi ki rod aur Zn2+ mahlool mein zinc ki rod, dono 1 mol dm-3, salt bridge aur 1.56 V parhte voltmeter se jude. Chandi musbat, zinc manfi, aur electrons zinc se chandi ki taraf. (b) Potential scale par Ag+/Ag +0.80 V aur Zn2+/Zn -0.76 V; dono ka farq 1.56 V hai.
blocks.caption: (a) Ag+/Ag, Zn2+/Zn electrochemical cell; (b) +0.80 V aur -0.76 V ka farq +1.56 V hai (Figure 10.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Standard cell potential
blocks.text: E cell = zyada musbat half-cell (jahan reduction hoti hai) ka E standard manfi zyada manfi half-cell (jahan oxidation hoti hai) ka E standard.

blocks.caption: Cell potentials
rows: +0.34 aur -0.44 V (print copper ke liye -0.44 V deti hai)

blocks.prompt: Ek cell mein standard nickel electrode (Ni2+/Ni, -0.25 V) aur standard cobalt electrode (Co2+/Co, -0.28 V) hain. Anode kaun sa hai, kul reaction kya hai, aur E cell kya hai (exercise Q.2k)?
blocks.explanation: Cobalt ka E standard zyada manfi hai, to woh oxidise hota hai: cobalt anode aur nickel cathode hai. Kul Co + Ni2+ se Co2+ + Ni. E cell = -0.25 - (-0.28) = +0.03 V.

items: E cell = E(zyada musbat) - E(zyada manfi); Ag/Zn: +0.80 - (-0.76) = +1.56 V; zyada musbat half-cell musbat pole hai.
